name: KMS Records
ownershipStory: Saunderson founded KMS in 1987 after watching Atkins and May run Metroplex and Transmat, initially to release his own and Inner City's material. The label later signed and developed artists including MK and Chez Damier.
hook: The third Belleville Three label, started once Saunderson saw his friends already running their own.

blurb.age7: Kevin Saunderson started his own label, KMS, and used it to release his hit song "Big Fun."
blurb.age13: Saunderson founded KMS in 1987, following Atkins and May, and used it to first press Inner City's "Big Fun" before it went on to sell widely through a major-label licensing deal.
blurb.adult: KMS completes the artist-owned label pattern of the Belleville Three, though it's also the one most associated with a licensing deal to a major (Virgin subsidiary 10 Records), a small but real crack in Detroit techno's otherwise consistent self-ownership story.
